options.content:
**PASS is one signal.** Review media counters, error history, temperature and telemetry coverage together. **N/A means unavailable or unsupported**, never an invented zero.

**Serial is the drive identity.** Device names can change after a reboot. Recorded pool membership covers cold/fast/ssd only; `unmapped` includes boot/system/spares/scratch and does not imply a disk is unused.

**Current gaps:** per-vdev ZFS READ/WRITE/CKSUM counts, last scrub result/age, detailed SMART self-test result/age, authoritative expected-drive inventory and bay mapping. These need additional collection before they can be charted. The existing boot-temperature alert still selects `sdk`; the live SATADOM is `sdm` (2026-10-08).
